title: Comprehensive Tax-Saving Comparison: ELSS vs PPF vs NPS
source: Income Tax Act 1961, Income Tax Act 2025 & Financial Planning Standards
reference: Section 80C & Section 80CCD(1B), Income Tax Act 1961 — recodified as Section 123 under Income Tax Act 2025
content: Comparing top tax-saving options for Tax Year 2026-27: 1. ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme): 3-year lock-in (shortest in 80C / Section 123), equity market returns (12-15%), LTCG above ₹1.25L taxed at 12.5%. 2. PPF (Public Provident Fund): 15-year lock-in, 7.1% fixed sovereign interest, 100% tax-free under EEE (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) status. 3. NPS (National Pension System): Lock-in till age 60, market-linked pension returns (9-11%), additional ₹50,000 tax deduction under Section 80CCD(1B) beyond the ₹1.5L 80C cap, 60% lump sum at 60 is tax-free.
